events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. The new CRM incorrectly added +1 to phone numbers; 31 migrated overseas customers are affected. Batches 4–10 would have the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the past 24 hours, though it is unknown whether they opened affected records. Please alert the sales team not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers and arrange identification and verification of the affected numbers and a fix to the migration’s country-code handling before migration resumes.
